source.public_api: unchanged; no compatibility interface, alias, shim, or second kernel
source.behavior: Rational and analytic selected-fiber contacts retain the weakest construction policy actually consumed. Their angle order/bracket queries use the requested replay policy. Rational tangent dot products use turn*cross(radius,target tangent), including retained pair-radial publication; existing turn-sign and contact factories replace duplicated construction.

regressions.baseline: Both certified contact replay paths reject STRICT; an approximate angle query incorrectly remains STRICT. A separate pre-orientation candidate reproduces Positive where the independent horizontal-circle tangent oracle requires Negative.
regressions.candidate: All four focused tests pass. Tests include both circle traversals, both horizontal cutter traversals, both requested policies, exact coordinate and tangent signs, actual sin(e)^2+cos(e)^2-1 terminal consumption, rejection of approximate retained evidence under STRICT, and preservation of strict evidence after an approximate query.

excluded_invocations.reason: Initial git apply from an unversioned archive ignored the regression paths. This is only an unmodified snapshot sanity pass; authoritative baseline regression logs come from the explicitly copied test source.

Intermediate policy fix passed analytic replay and requested-policy checks but the strengthened exact tangent assertion exposed the pre-existing orientation error. These artifacts are not the final candidate.

memory.scope: Paired whole-process peak RSS only; no fresh allocator or complete heap recording in this checkpoint.

limitations: Not a uniform performance or full Hypercurve release-readiness claim.
ExactCorelib idea mining/uplift remains closed; lower-stack and Hypermesh source are unchanged in this slice.
Concurrent Hyperreal formatting work is preserved, not committed or qualified by these pinned-snapshot results.
Owned build, test and profile workers were finished before paired timings; existing desktop processes were not stopped or controlled.
followups: Rational overlap map construction still captures requested policy before later boundary decisions; do not blindly weaken that early capture. Audit publication after all consumed predicates.
The rational-circle component boundary seeding still assumes an algebraic center after refinement. Reuse the shared finite-fiber authority and prove the exact-center overlap case separately.

Other mapped angle queries must be reviewed together with their retained caches before changing their query policy. This checkpoint changes the uncached selected-fiber maps, not every mapped-circle cache.
Rational equality's measured wide-cross-product allocation dominance and the one-item coarse-sign loop remain separate candidates, not changes delivered here.

reproduction.timings:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
replay_root=/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/strict-contact-replay.iVykgE
for replay_round in 1 2 3; do
    if (( replay_round % 2 )); then
        replay_order="baseline candidate"
    else
        replay_order="candidate baseline"
    fi
    for replay_case in selected chord radial contacts; do
        case "$replay_case" in
            selected) replay_test=selected_fiber_genuinely_analytic_contacts_complete_region_booleans ;;
            chord) replay_test=recursive_selected_radial_diameter_chord_intersects_a_rational_quadratic_strict ;;
            radial) replay_test=recursively_pair_radial_circle_intersects_a_genuine_analytic_parallel ;;
            contacts) replay_test=selected_parallel_normal_circle_retains_general_rational_contacts_in_one_fiber ;;
        esac
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$replay_root/paired-$replay_case-$replay_round-$replay_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_root/$replay_variant-test" \
                "bezier_offset::conversion_tests::$replay_test" --exact --include-ignored --test-threads=1 \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_case-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
            printf '%s %s %s passed\n' "$replay_case" "$replay_round" "$replay_variant"
        done
    done
    for replay_bench in bezier_region rational_bezier; do
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$replay_root/paired-$replay_bench-$replay_round-$replay_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_root/$replay_variant-$replay_bench" \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_bench-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
    for replay_fixture in rectangles circles capsules; do
        unset HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE
        if [[ "$replay_fixture" != rectangles ]]; then
            export HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE="$replay_fixture"
        fi
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_ITERATIONS=1000 \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_root/$replay_variant-curve_region_boolean_batch" \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_fixture-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
done
